text: First appearing in Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975), this Russian mutant's younger sister Illyana was abducted to the demonic dimension of Limbo, where she aged seven years and returned as the sorceress Magik. Name this armored X-Man.
hint: You could say his stature among mutants is truly 'colossal', and he's got nerves of organic steel!

text: Before wielding the Infinity Gauntlet, Thanos's iconic throne made its comic debut in Iron Man #55 (1973). What title is traditionally held by the cosmic entity that Thanos constantly seeks to impress?
hint: Thanos didn't ghost her, but dating a skeleton lady is the ultimate 'dead-end' relationship.

text: In Jonathan Hickman's 2015 Secret Wars buildup, the collision of two universal Earths at a single point of impact is called what catastrophic phenomenon?
hint: Sounds like a fun school field trip (excursion), except two planets crash into each other head-on!

text: Doctor Doom rules the sovereign European nation of Latveria from Castle Doom. What is the name of his mechanical army composed of lifelike robotic duplicates designed to confuse assassins?
hint: Take the dictator's favorite surname and add 'bots'. Victor isn't winning any awards for creative branding.

text: At San Diego Comic-Con 2024, Marvel Studios dropped a multiverse megaton when Kevin Feige brought dozens of green-cloaked figures onto the Hall H stage. One of them stepped forward, pulled off his iconic chrome Doctor Doom mask to a deafening crowd roar, revealing that the former bedrock face of the Marvel Cinematic Universe was returning to lead 'Avengers: Doomsday' and 'Avengers: Secret Wars'. Which Oscar-winning actor shocked the world with this villainous reveal?
hint: You either die an iron-clad hero, or you live long enough to get paid over $80 million dollars to return as the greatest dictator in comic book history!

text: Magik's signature weapon is forged from her own life energy and magical essence in the Limbo dimension. What is this blade called?
hint: It's got plenty of Motown rhythm and blues, cutting straight to your metaphysical core!

text: Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin of Crime, made his comic debut in The Amazing Spider-Man #50 (1967). What famed Daredevil villain and marksman was hired by Kingpin to eliminate Matt Murdock?
hint: He never misses target practice, and his name is literally the red center of a dartboard.

text: In the legendary 1996 Capcom fighting game 'X-Men vs. Street Fighter', what is the special crossover command that allows both of your selected tag-team characters to attack on screen simultaneously?
hint: Two fighters, one screen, maximum hype! Think 'Variable' or 'Hyper' team teamwork.

text: What enchanted inscription is etched into the side of Mjolnir, beginning with the words: 'Whosoever holds this hammer...'?
answer: '...if he be worthy, shall possess the power of Thor.'
hint: An elevator can go up, but that doesn't make it 'virtuous' enough for Asgardian standards!

text: In 2015's Secret Wars, Victor Von Doom usurped the power of the Beyonders and ruled the patchwork remnants of the multiverse under what regal title?
hint: Doctor wasn't prestigious enough, King was too mortal... so he promoted himself to the Almighty ruler of an Empire!
